This comes as a ceasefire brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump took effect across the frontline region of Kherson on Tuesday. Families were reunited at a site in the region of Chernihiv in northern Ukraine after arriving in buses and ambulances. They had previously travelled via Crimea and Russia after their evacuation from the Ukrainian town on Friday. Ceasefire measures will remain in place until the end of Sunday 1 November. Keeping the roots intact, conservationists carefully lift shoots from a donor meadow of seagrass and place them in a bag. They only take a few shoots from each spot, which will be planted where the conservationists hope to regrow another meadow. They've already picked out a prime area for the young plants, which need sandy sediment, shelter from waves and currents and sufficient light and oxygen to thrive. The scientists see the work as critical. Myriam Spicka, who heads the NGO Seagrass Conservation, says she has "seen the changes" in the more than 30 years she's been diving.
